rule.message:
All students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements.
Collegiate Requirements:
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) must complete the First-Year Experience course sequence.
All students must complete a capstone in at least one CLA major. The requirements for double majors completing the capstone in a different CLA major will be clearly stated. Students must also complete all major requirements in both majors to allow the additional capstone to be waived. Students completing an additional degree must complete the Capstone in each degree area.
At least 28 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus.
Students may earn no more than one undergraduate degree from the Theatre Arts Program: a BA in Theatre Arts, or a BFA in Acting, or a minor in Theatre Arts.
All Acting BFA students participate in the London Study Abroad program during the Fall semester of their junior year. The courses taken in London are included in these requirements.
View sample plans for this program here: https://sampleplan.umn.edu/node/301 Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Entry into the BFA acting program is by audition only. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
